items.title: Einspruch (objection) against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter printed/posted 18.11.2026 (Wed); no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so the posting day is 18.11.2026. For letters posted from 1 Jan 2025, delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO): 18.11 +4 days = 22.11.2026, a Sunday. For tax offices, if that 4th day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deemed delivery day moves to the next working day (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO): next working day is Monday 23.11.2026, so Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) is counted under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the delivery day itself is not counted; the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). That day is neither a weekend day nor a public holiday in MV, so no extension under § 108 Abs. 3 AO/§ 193 BGB is needed.
